items.title: A weakly etale ring map becomes ind-etale after a faithfully flat ind-etale extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition proves that for a weakly etale ring map A -> B there is a faithfully flat ind-etale B -> B' with A -> B' ind-etale (statement lines 1801-1806). The proof (proof lines 1808-1834) passes to a diagram with w-local spectra and strictly henselian local rings, shows that the map between the middle and top identifies local rings using rigidity of weakly etale maps between strictly henselian local rings, and applies the local isomorphism proposition. H2: a three-step reduction with four inputs, written out in full.
